info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Event Notifications API
info.description: The Event Notifications API facilitates the real-time delivery of banking event notifications. It empowers financial institutions and third-party developers to subscribe to and manage event notifications effectively, ensuring timely updates on critical activities such as account changes or transaction statuses. This API is designed for use cases that require immediate awareness of banking events, offering seamless integration for applications that enhance user experience or compliance. Typical consumers include fintech companies, banking partners, and app developers seeking to leverage event-driven architectures.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new event notification in the system. By sending a POST request with the necessary data, users can successfully register an event that they want to be notified about.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary to create and send an event notification. It should include all relevant information required for processing the event, structured according to the specified schema.
